stem: How do the events in paragraph 13 of the story “Tasha’s Hat” contribute to the plot?

options.label: A
options.text: There is a new conflict when Sophie mentions that winter is over.

options.label: B
options.text: The setting is explained when Sophie talks to Tasha in the store.

options.label: C
options.text: There is a turning point when Sophie notices the hat Tasha wanted before.

options.label: D
options.text: A lesson is learned when Sophie interrupts herself while she is talking.
